Entire place
Entire places are best if you're seeking a home away from home. With an entire place, you'll have the whole space to yourself. This usually includes a bedroom, a bathroom, a kitchen, and a separate, dedicated entrance. Hosts should note in the description if they'll be on the property or not (ex: "Host occupies first floor of the home"), and provide further details on the listing.

Private rooms
Private rooms are great for when you prefer a little privacy, and still value a local connection. When you book a private room, you'll have your own private room for sleeping and may share some spaces with others. You might need to walk through indoor spaces that another host or guest may occupy to get to your room.

Shared rooms
Shared rooms are for when you don't mind sharing a space with others. When you book a shared room, you'll be sleeping in a space that is shared with others and share the entire space with other people. Shared rooms are popular among flexible travelers looking for new friends and budget-friendly stays.

Cleaned price value with dollar signs and commas removed. Used as base for all price-related calculations.

Natural logarithm of (beds + 1). Uses log1p to handle zero values.

Actual booked days in last 365 days (from Airbnb booking data). More accurate than calendar-based proxies as it excludes host-blocked days.
True occupancy rate: estimated_occupancy_l365d / 365. Uses actual booked days (preferred metric). Note: Capped at 0.699 (69.9%) due to 255-day limit in estimated_occupancy_l365d.
Binary flag: 1 if estimated_occupancy_l365d = 255 (capped at 8-bit integer limit)
Reference: 0 otherwise. Indicates listings where true occupancy may be higher than reported (no adjustment applied).

Description: Calendar-based proxy: (365 - availability_365) / 365. Includes booked + host-blocked + maintenance days (less accurate than occupancy_rate). Full 0-1 range (not capped).
Estimated annual revenue: price_clean × estimated_occupancy_l365d. Uses actual booked days when available (preferred). Falls back to calendar availability if estimated_occupancy_l365d not available.
Calendar-based revenue estimate: price_clean × (365 - availability_365). Fallback metric when estimated_occupancy_l365d not available.
Revenue per guest capacity: est_annual_revenue / accommodates. Unit economics metric.
Revenue per bedroom: est_annual_revenue / bedrooms. Only calculated for listings with bedrooms > 0.
Natural logarithm of est_annual_revenue. Log-transformed revenue for percentage analysis.
